title: Paired scan of two lists
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $G_0,G_1$ each take three optional cell values to an optional cell value, and let $u,u'$ be finite lists of Boolean symbols. Pair the lists position by position, apply the paired scan transition successively across the resulting list of pairs, starting from two initial scan states together with counter $0$ and a function assigning $(	ext{false},	ext{false})$ at every argument, and return the pair of scan states in the resulting accumulator.
